verdict.rationale: Riskified is a fraud-decisioning platform, so team review workflows are a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence covers only automated approve/decline/review recommendations, API endpoints, notifications and SSO. Nothing documents case assignment, escalation, SLAs, or an audit trail of who approved what and why.

support.subject: As an ops user, review work is a team workflow — assignment, escalation, SLAs, and a decision audit trail that shows who approved what and why
